product.name: Lilac Orchid Keychain
product.description: A handmade lilac orchid keychain crafted petal by petal with soft pipe cleaners. Finished with delicate floral details and a metal keyring, it’s a lightweight statement accessory for keys, bags, backpacks, or pouches.

product.name: The Blush Lotus Jewlery Tray
product.description:
A handmade lotus bloom designed to hold the little treasures you reach for every day. Crafted petal by petal in soft white with blush-pink detailing and fresh green leaves, The Blush Lotus doubles as an elegant jewelry holder for rings, earrings, chains, and other small keepsakes.

Each piece is shaped entirely by hand, making every lotus slightly unique.

product.name: Golden Hour Bouquet
product.description: A warm handmade arrangement featuring a bold golden sunflower, delicate white mini daisies, and soft greenery, finished in sleek black wrapping with an ivory satin bow. Designed to bring a little sunshine to birthdays, congratulations, thank-yous, or simply “thinking of you” moments.
